## Summary

Describe the user or operational outcome and the affected boundaries.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the change.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Security, migration, accessibility, or performance gates were run when relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated test artifacts, or internal notes are included.

## Release notes

List migrations, configuration changes, rollout conditions, and rollback considerations. Write `None` when not applicable.
